Why you are so special

Some people simply stay in your life. You do more than that. You make life softer, sweeter, and so much better.

🫶

You take care of me

In all the little everyday ways that matter the most. You notice, you help, you protect, and you make me feel looked after without ever making it feel heavy.

🍝

You cook for me

And somehow every meal feels like love. It is not just food — it is your warmth, your effort, and the comfort only you know how to give.

✨

You do everything

You show up. You care. You make things easier. You bring light into my life, and you do it so naturally that it feels like magic.

Our favorite little moments

The best part of love is often hidden inside the small, random, unforgettable moments. These photos feel exactly like that.

01 — Soft winter love

Cold air, warm scarves, and the kind of kiss that makes the whole world disappear for a second.

02 — The playful chaos

The kind of moment that is impossible to stage — messy, funny, spontaneous, and completely us.

03 — A calm little forever

The sweetest feeling: being close to you and knowing that this is exactly where I want to be.

A letter for you

Because some people deserve more than a simple thank you.

My Kami,

I wanted to make you something that feels a little more personal, because you deserve something beautiful. You are one of those rare people who makes love feel easy. You take care of me, you cook for me, you show up for me, and you do it all with a heart that feels so warm and genuine.

I love the quiet things about us just as much as the loud, funny, chaotic ones. The kisses in random places. The laughter. The comfort. The way being with you can turn an ordinary day into one of my favorite memories.

Thank you for being so thoughtful, so loving, and so deeply you. If I could wrap appreciation, affection, and admiration into one little world, it would look like this page.

You really do so much, and I hope you always know how loved you are.

With all my love ♡

Little reminder

You are not just appreciated for what you do. You are loved for who you are.

Always true

Home is not always a place. Sometimes, home is a person — and for me, that feeling is you.

Made with love, memories, and way too many hearts — just for Kami. 💞
